escenas.texto: This week in Europe, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over two hundred and forty-seven million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Europe edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Europe. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Coming in at number ten, from Spain, Dagar, with a video posted five days ago. Over five point seven million views. A video over twenty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has seven hundred and two comments.

In position number nine, PORTIA AI STORY LITH , with a video posted two days ago. Over five point nine million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It got there in just two days.

In position number eight, from United Kingdom, Mat Armstrong MK2, with “Attempting to fix the misfiring bugatti chiron”. Over six point nine million views. A video over forty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.
At number seven, from Spain, Miguel ASSAL , with a video posted two days ago. Over seven point seven million views. A Short of just thirty-seven seconds. It got there in just two days.
Number six, from Austria, Red Bull, with “Always Keep Going”. Over eight million views. A Short of just thirty seconds. It also has four hundred and sixty-nine comments.

Number five, from Belgium, Blin., with “How to Crack Lucia in GTA 6 Most People Miss This”. Over eight point six million views. And get this: it's a channel with about sixty-two thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifty-seven seconds.
Next up, number four, FORMULA 1, with “Race Highlights 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix”. Over ten million views. It also has over eight thousand comments.

Bronze medal, from United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with “Why GTA is a Bigger Deal Than You Think”. Over eleven million views. A video over forty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over five thousand comments.
Silver medal, from Türkiye, Mr Spring, with “Did GTA 6 Finally Fix BLOCKED Car Doors?”. Over nineteen million views. A Short of just thirty-six seconds. It also has over three thousand comments.

And finally, number one most viewed, SEEDPIT Official, with “Kevin says Seed is TOO SMALL”. Over twenty-eight million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and ninety thousand views per hour. A Short of just thirty-nine seconds.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Number ten, from Ukraine, Domer Grief, with a video posted three days ago. Over five thousand comments. A video over twenty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over one point one million views.
Number nine, from United Kingdom, Unknown Player, with a video posted three days ago. Over five thousand comments. It also has over one point seven million views.

Coming in at number eight, from United Kingdom, Mat Armstrong MK2, with “Attempting to fix the misfiring bugatti chiron”. Over five thousand comments. A video over forty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

Next up, number seven, Jazzghost, with a video posted four days ago. Over seven thousand comments. A video over one hundred and thirty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over four million views.

In position number six, from United Kingdom, Could You Survive History?, with “GTA 6 Is the Most Expensive Flop Ever Made”. Over seven thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about one thousand, nine hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It got there in just two days.
Next up, number five, from United Kingdom, DanTDM, with “This Is Why You Hate GTA 6 rant”. Over seven thousand comments. It also has over two point five million views.

Coming in at number four, FORMULA 1, with “Race Highlights 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix”. Over eight thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and thirty thousand views per hour. It also has over ten million views.

Bronze medal, from United Kingdom, IAmBeanz, with “GTA 6 Feels Like Something's Off...”. Over nine thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about five thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over one point six million views.
Silver medal, from France, Ninjaxx, with a video posted five days ago. Over thirteen thousand comments. It also has over one point three million views.

And finally, number one most commented, HYPNOS CR, with a video posted two days ago. Over sixteen thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: twenty-four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over thirty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Coming in at number ten, from Austria, Red Bull, with “Always Keep Going”. Over one hundred and eight thousand likes. A Short of just thirty seconds. It also has over eight million views.

In position number nine, from France, Ninjaxx, with a video posted five days ago. Over one hundred and eight thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: nine out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over one point three million views.
In position number eight, FORMULA 1, with “Race Highlights 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix”. Over one hundred and thirty-one thousand likes. It also has over ten million views.

Coming in at number seven, from United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with “Why GTA is a Bigger Deal Than You Think”. Over one hundred and thirty-two thousand likes. A video over forty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over eleven million views.

Next up, number six, SEEDPIT Official, with “Can Kevin FEED Seed to the BIRDS?”. Over one hundred and forty-four thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and forty thousand views per hour. A Short of just fifty-six seconds.
In position number five, from Spain, Miguel ASSAL , with a video posted two days ago. Over one hundred and fifty thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-seven seconds. It got there in just two days.

In position number four, from Belgium, Blin., with “How to Crack Lucia in GTA 6 Most People Miss This”. Over one hundred and eighty-six thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about sixty-two thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifty-seven seconds.

Bronze medal, from United Kingdom, Mat Armstrong MK2, with “Attempting to fix the misfiring bugatti chiron”. Over one hundred and ninety-seven thousand likes. A video over forty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.
Silver medal, PORTIA AI STORY LITH , with a video posted two days ago. Over two hundred and ninety-eight thousand likes. It got there in just two days. It also has over five point nine million views.

And here it is. Number one most liked, from Türkiye, Mr Spring, with “Did GTA 6 Finally Fix BLOCKED Car Doors?”. Over three hundred and three thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-six seconds. It also has over nineteen million views.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: the Americas. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Europe every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
